Name: Country Haley
Author: monteso
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE


As Haley's relationship meter starts to increase you start to find her beginning to change. Caring less about fashion and looks. I felt that her appearance should reflect this change in attitude. So awhile ago I made this , for my own use, but have since decided to share. Haley will now be wearing a flannel shirt and have her hair tied back. Comes in two versions, "Busty" and "Modest".

The Busty verison is a edited version of 3dgamerman (AirplaneRandy) 's "Buxom Cleavage Portraits" mod. Check it out and its fully clothed version.

[u]Install info
[/u] Open the 7z file in 7-zip, Pick only one portrait verison to use, place the Character and Portrait files into the appropriate file locations. StardewValley/Content/Portraits and Content/Characters.

[u][b]Install info Content Patcher pack only[/b]

[/u][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download mod pack  and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Open config file. select preferred version: skirt, skirthat, jean, jeanhat. Busty: true/false
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
